description: Screenshot of Q post 3651 (Dec 6 2019, 15:48:08 EST) with an attached movie-poster-style FISAGATE meme. The poster shows Barack Obama at top over faces including Hillary Clinton, James Comey, and figures consistent with Andrew McCabe and Loretta Lynch, styled like a film one-sheet with five-star review blurbs attributed to Reps. Mark Meadows, Jim Jordan, Steve King, Matt Gaetz and Scott Perry. The Q text asks whether those responsible for an attempted coup against the President will go unpunished, ending Enjoy the show!
text: Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 No.92 3651. Dec 6 2019 15:48:08 (EST). ELIZFpfU0AAfYCg.png. FISAGATE. "What I saw is absolutely shocking." Mark Meadows. "It is so alarming the American people have to see this" Jim Jordan. "The sickening reality has set in. I no longer hold out hope there is an innocent explanation for the information the public has seen." Steve King. "There has been a real attempt to undermine this President & it comes from the reaches of places." Matt Gaetz. "As soon as you read the Memo, you think, is this happening in America or is this the KGB?" Scott Perry. People actually believe those responsible for the attempted coup [coup attempt] of a duly elected sitting US President will go unpunished? End to our Constitutional Republic? No equal justice under the law? No accountability? Escape unscathed? Enjoy the show! Q
flags: Poster implies the pictured officials committed a coup — an unproven claim carried as the meme's claim
Two poster faces identified as consistent with Andrew McCabe and Loretta Lynch, not certain
Small quote blurbs transcribed best-effort; some tiny text partially legible

description: Screenshot of Q post 4014 (April 30 2020) from a dark-themed Q aggregator site. The post links a Washington Examiner article about the Democratic National Convention being pushed back to mid-August and poses a long list of rhetorical questions suggesting the delay, mail-in voting, COVID-19 measures and a possible change of candidate are strategic moves to ensure a Democratic victory. Ends with Define insurgency.
text: 4014. Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 04/30/20 16:50:58 ID: 1656e4. Archive Bread/Post Links: 8976111 / 8976284. Direct Link: 8976284. https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/democratic-national-convention-pushed-back-a-month-to-mid-august. Why are they pushing back the [D] convention?. COVID-19 concern or strategic for last minute change?. Change of Batter coming?. Why was she 'saved' from officially announcing?. Why was she 'reserved' for a last minute change?. How do you attempt to 'sneak one in'?. How do you attempt to ensure victory?. Adopt National Vote-by-Mail?. How do you convince American it was legitimate?. Release fake polls indicating favorable leads in swing states?. How do you harm opponents accomplishments re: economy, unemployment, ...................?. How do you terminate opponents highly effective rallies?. How do you shelter [D] lead candidate from embarrassing debates and/or rallies?. How do you shelter [D] corruption re: FISA-RUSSIA-FLYNN-etc. from reaching the mainstream?. How do you extend the trade negotiation deadline w/ CHINA?. How do you limit [test] Constitutional rights of people?. How do you provide cover for State Govs to adopt new voter laws?. How do you effectively control the population?. How do you expand big tech overreach re: tracing / privacy issues?. How do you fix [taxpayer bailout?] the long-broken economies of CA & NY?. How do you enrich select people/co's by promoting a solution to a global crisis?. How do you keep people living in fear and isolation in order to accept the above?. Define 'insurgency'.. How do you accomplish all of the above?. Q
flags: Post asserts unverified claims that the convention delay, COVID measures and mail-in voting are an election-rigging strategy — carried as the drop's claims
'she' (a candidate allegedly held in reserve) is implied but not named in the post

description: Screenshot of a tweet by Florida attorney and state legislator Anthony Sabatini announcing that the State Attorney's Office for the 6th Judicial Circuit dropped its case against his client, described as the first Floridian arrested for opening a non-essential business during COVID-19 emergency orders. Attached is a photographed State of Florida 'No Information' court filing dated 4/30/20, signed by State Attorney Bernie McCabe, declining prosecution on two counts of violation of emergency order.
text: Anthony Sabatini @AnthonySa... 16h. The State Attorney's Office 6th Circuit just DROPPED their case against my client Galen Wood—the first Floridian to be arrested for opening a "non-essential" business. It's clear there is NO valid legal authority for either the state or local emergency orders. #liberty #COVID19. 20-04781-MM-F. 522020MM004781000APC. STATE OF FLORIDA. v. GALEN TRENT WOOD. PID 3302307. 1 VIOLATION OF EMERGENCY ORDER. 2 VIOLATION OF EMERGENCY ORDER. NO INFORMATION. The State Attorney, having conducted an investigation in this matter, concludes that the facts and circumstances revealed do not warrant prosecution at this time. Dated: 4/30/20. BERNIE McCABE, State Attorney. Sixth Judicial Circuit of Florida. 56. 484. 751
orgs: State Attorney's Office Sixth Judicial Circuit of Florida
flags: Defendant is a private individual named in the tweet and court document as Galen Trent Wood; not independently identified
Tweet's claim that emergency orders lack valid legal authority is the author's opinion, not a court finding

description: Black-and-white meme built on a portrait photograph of Donald Trump seated in a dark suit and tie, pointing at the viewer. Overlaid text presents the widely circulated slogan that his opponents are really after his supporters and he is merely in the way.
text: IN REALITY THEY'RE NOT AFTER ME THEY'RE AFTER YOU. I'M JUST IN THE WAY

description: Screenshot of a verified @realDonaldTrump tweet dated May 3 2020. President Trump claims intelligence officials reported the coronavirus was not raised with him until late January 2020, just before his China travel ban, and then only in a non-threatening, matter-of-fact manner.
text: Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump. Intelligence has just reported to me that I was correct, and that they did NOT bring up the CoronaVirus subject matter until late into January, just prior to my banning China from the U.S. Also, they only spoke of the Virus in a very non-threatening, or matter of fact, manner... 1:18 PM · May 3, 2020 · Twitter for iPhone
flags: Tweet's account of what intelligence briefings contained is the author's claim and was disputed in contemporaneous reporting
